# `date_trunc`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns timestamp `ts` truncated to the unit specified by the format model `fmt`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
date_trunc(fmt, ts)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- date_trunc, example 1
> SELECT date_trunc('YEAR', '2015-03-05T09:32:05.359');
2015-01-01 00:00:00
```

```sql
-- date_trunc, example 2
> SELECT date_trunc('MM', '2015-03-05T09:32:05.359');
2015-03-01 00:00:00
```

```sql
-- date_trunc, example 3
> SELECT date_trunc('DD', '2015-03-05T09:32:05.359');
2015-03-05 00:00:00
```

```sql
-- date_trunc, example 4
> SELECT date_trunc('HOUR', '2015-03-05T09:32:05.359');
2015-03-05 09:00:00
```

```sql
-- date_trunc, example 5
> SELECT date_trunc('MILLISECOND', '2015-03-05T09:32:05.123456');
2015-03-05 09:32:05.123
```
